name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 8 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-11-24, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
